title: Uncrate: Bamboo Bicycle Club
body_html:
US gear and lifestyle site Uncrate picked Bamboo Bicycle Club as one of its video features, describing the club in a single line:

"They build bikes from custom bamboo frames, and they love what they do." — Uncrate

The pick pointed to footage of the club's bamboo frame building — the bespoke, build-it-yourself approach that has run out of the London workshops since 2012.

See the original on Uncrate: Bamboo Bicycle Club.
